title: Polaris Key config catalog (.pkey/schema)
description: The schema document of a .pkey/ manifest: the product's config catalog — a schemaVersion plus one ConfigEntry per declarable key. Each entry's own `schema` field is a nested JSON-Schema fragment (the Draft-07 subset @polaris-key/catalog validates values against) — do not confuse the two layers. Mirrors validateCatalogShape and validateCloudSync in @polaris-key/manifest; the TypeScript validator is authoritative. The $id URL is an identifier, not a fetchable locator — this file ships inside the @polaris-key/manifest npm package.

schemaVersion.description: The catalog's shape version; bumped on incompatible changes and echoed in the signed config document.

catalog.description: Deprecated: write entries. Still accepted (plans/ST-19.md); pkey validate warns with deprecated_spelling.

key.description: Dotted identifier, unique within the catalog (e.g. run.concurrency). On a flag, the names channels, deviceLimit, app.minVersion, app.maxVersion, license.tier and license.tierLabel, and every name under license., app. and pkey., are reserved entitlement names the platform sets itself: a declaration of one must match the system key's type (channels an array of strings, deviceLimit an integer, app.* and license.* strings) and may only narrow it. The validator reports an incompatible one (incompatible_reserved_name) as a warning or an error, as the platform's licensing.reservedNames setting says; this schema does not check it.

kind.description: config = plaintext client setting · secret = redacted, delivered to the OS keyring · flag = an entitlement.

schema.description: A JSON-Schema fragment (the Draft-07 subset @polaris-key/catalog supports — unsupported keywords are rejected at publish time, never silently ignored) that values of this key must satisfy.

default.description: Schema-level default — the client's last-resort fallback.

managementDefault.description: CONFIG kinds only: the management state a freshly-minted key gets — default (overridable) · enforced (server wins) · hidden (enforced + withheld from enumeration).

delivery.description: SECRET kinds only: serverOnly (never leaves the worker) · clientScoped (delivered to the device keyring) · edgeMint (minted on demand at /<product>/config/mint/*).

userGrant.description: FLAG kinds: surfaced to the user as an included capability.

ui.description: Rendering hints only — never affect validation.

dependsOn.description: Presentation gating: show this entry only when another key equals a value.

accessor.description: Dotted path into the client's config object (config/secret kinds).

user.description: CONFIG kinds only: tunes a synced setting. Every Editable config key (no managementDefault of enforced or hidden) syncs for a signed-in person while Cloud Sync is on, with or without this block; on a locked key the block has no effect (a validator warning). sync: user (default; roams everywhere) · platform (within desktop, mobile, console or web) · local (never leaves the device). conflict: lastWrite (default) · max · min (number schemas) · merge (object schemas, per top-level member; a set is an object of booleans); never union or revision. listed: shown in settings panels (default true).

allOf.$comment: delivery is only valid for secret entries.
managementDefault is only valid for config entries.

user is only valid on config entries (user_setting_wrong_kind). On a key whose managementDefault is enforced or hidden it has no effect, which the validator reports as a warning (user_setting_locked_default).

cloudSync.description: The data shape of the product's Cloud Sync records (the Cloud Sync service): its collections and the migrations the server applies to synced values. A person's quota is not here: it is the pkey.cloudSync.bytes entitlement a tier, a licence override or an add-on sets.

name.description: [A-Za-z0-9._:-], at most 128 characters; a trailing .* makes a pattern matching every collection with that prefix. Names are unique and patterns disjoint.

label.description: Shown in the console and the portal. Default: the template's label, else the name.

template.description: saves (save slots: revision, 16 slots per person, a 32 MiB file with 5 older versions, and playtime, progress, chapter, formatVersion and a base64 thumbnail of about 32 KiB) · session (lastWrite, 16 records, an 8 MiB file with 1 older version). The declaration's own members override the template's, except a saves collection's slot count.

access.description: owner, the only value (the signed-in person's devices read and write); omit it.

conflict.description: revision (compare-and-swap, default) · lastWrite · max · min (the record whose conflictField is larger or smaller) · merge (per top-level field) · union (a set: array schema with uniqueItems). The server applies every policy.

conflictField.description: For max and min only: the number property of the schema the server compares.

schema.description: A Draft-07-subset schema every record value must satisfy.

maxRecords.description: The most records one person keeps here (at most 10,000). Not allowed on a saves collection: its 16 slots are a platform constant.

files.description: The one file a record may carry: its largest size in bytes (at most 1 GiB) and how many older versions are kept.

requires.description: An entitlement the anchor licence must grant before a record is written: a catalog flag or a system entitlement.

allOf.$comment: A saves collection's slots are a platform constant (16), so it may not set maxRecords.

rename.description: Old key → new key; every target is a declared key, and no key is both renamed and dropped.

mapValues.description: Per key, an object of old value → new value.
